decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Details of provision for people with disabilities,  including the handrails  to the front entrance steps, adaption of the existing doors to be power assisted, tonal colours to the steps, widening of pathways and provision of kerbs around the planting area including materials and finish at scale 1:20 to be submitted  and agreed in writing by the LPA before the commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - Details of internal fixing of partitions to the existing walls and of any insulation for walls, at a  scale 1:20, to be submitted  and agreed in writing by the LPA before the commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.
description: Internal alterations to form medical consulting rooms and offices with the installation of partition walls.
